# Mr. Bin

> Mr. Bin washes, sanitizes, and deodorizes trash bins at the curb in Stafford, VA 22554 and Fredericksburg, VA 22401. $25 first bin, $20 each additional bin, per visit. No subscription, no contract — you pay only when we clean.

## Key facts

- Business: Mr. Bin — trash bin washing, sanitizing, and deodorizing
- Service areas: Stafford, VA 22554 and Fredericksburg, VA 22401
- Pricing: $25 first bin, $20 each additional bin, per visit; typical two-bin home $45
- Terms: pay-per-visit only; no subscription, no contract
- Clean day: the day after trash pickup (clean day = trash day + 1)
- No need to be home — bins cleaned at the curb; photo texted when done
- Year-round service, including winter
- Phone: (571) 589-5542
- Email: MrBinllc@gmail.com
- Website: https://mrbinusa.com
